title: Mayor's Tree Lighting Holiday Show 2026
seo_title: Mayor's Tree Lighting Holiday Show 2026 in Springfield, MO
description: The Mayor's Tree Lighting Holiday Show is a holiday festival held outdoors on Park Central Square in downtown Springfield, Missouri, where visitors can attend the Springfield Christmas Parade from 3 to 5 p.m. and stay for the tree lighting from 5 to 8 p.m. It takes place on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at Park Central Square, 201 Park Central W, Springfield, MO.
